entries.title: Exodus 27:1
segments: ¶"You shall make an altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide-the altar shall be square-and its height [shall be] three cubits.

entries.title: Exodus 27:2
segments: "You shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it. And you shall overlay it with bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:3
segments: "Also you shall make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels and its basins and its forks and its firepans; you shall make all its utensils of bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:4
segments: "You shall make a grate for it, a network of bronze; and on the network you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.

entries.title: Exodus 27:5
segments: "You shall put it under the rim of the altar beneath, that the network may be midway up the altar.

entries.title: Exodus 27:6
segments: "And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:7
segments: "The poles shall be put in the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar to bear it.

entries.title: Exodus 27:8
segments: "You shall make it hollow with boards; as it was shown you on the mountain, so shall they make [it].

entries.title: Exodus 27:9
segments: ¶"You shall also make the court of the tabernacle. For the south side [there shall be] hangings for the court [made of] fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long for one side.

entries.title: Exodus 27:10
segments: "And its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets [shall be] bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands [shall be] silver.

entries.title: Exodus 27:11
segments: "Likewise along the length of the north side [there shall be] hangings one hundred [cubits] long, with its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of bronze, and the hooks of the pillars and their bands of silver.

entries.title: Exodus 27:12
segments: "And along the width of the court on the west side [shall be] hangings of fifty cubits, with their ten pillars and their ten sockets.

entries.title: Exodus 27:13
segments: "The width of the court on the east side [shall be] fifty cubits.

entries.title: Exodus 27:14
segments: "The hangings on [one] side [of the gate shall be] fifteen cubits, [with] their three pillars and their three sockets.

entries.title: Exodus 27:15
segments: "And on the other side [shall be] hangings of fifteen [cubits, with] their three pillars and their three sockets.

entries.title: Exodus 27:16
segments: "For the gate of the court [there shall be] a screen twenty cubits long, [woven of] blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], and fine woven linen, made by a weaver. It [shall have] four pillars and four sockets.

entries.title: Exodus 27:17
segments: "All the pillars around the court shall have bands of silver; their hooks [shall be] of silver and their sockets of bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:18
segments: "The length of the court [shall be] one hundred cubits, the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, [made of] fine woven linen, and its sockets of bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:19
segments: "All the utensils of the tabernacle for all its service, all its pegs, and all the pegs of the court, [shall be] of bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:20
segments: ¶"And you shall command the children of Israel that they bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually.

entries.title: Exodus 27:21
segments: "In the tabernacle of meeting, outside the veil which [is] before the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening until morning before the LORD. [It shall be]  a statute forever to their generations on behalf of the children of Israel.
